lines: Allen's running has dropped: 3.7 carries per game over his last 3 games against 6.6 for the season, and he's averaging 15.8 PPR points over that stretch.
The coach said Buffalo should not throw 45 times when leading, and he stays hesitant to call goal-line sneaks or keepers for Allen.
Week 12 is against KC, which allows the 30th-most PPR points per game to QBs, and Buffalo's implied team total is 25.2 points.
